title: Bewilder
summary: BEWIL'DER, verb transitive To lead into perplexity or confusion; to lose in pathless places; to confound for want of a plain road; to perplex with mazes; or in general, to perplex. Lost and bewildered

inlines.v: BEWIL'DER, verb transitive To lead into perplexity or confusion; to lose in pathless places; to confound for want of a plain road; to perplex with mazes; or in general, to perplex. Lost and bewildered in the fruitless search.
